title: Measuring the Prior Season Spend on a Long-Standing Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
On an account that has been open for several crop years the spend a prepay ceiling is measured on is taken over a longer view than the season just closed, and how much longer follows the acres enrolled on it.

**Clause.** Where the account has been open for at least thirty-six whole months, counted from the date it was opened to the handling date, and the acres enrolled on it are at or above the programme's rebate threshold in acres, the prior season spend is half of everything invoiced to the account over the 26 statement months before the handling date, less every discount granted on the account as a discount line of its own, which is an early pay, volume, prepay or programme rebate discount and never the restocking charge withheld inside a credit memo, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places, which is the average of the two crop years just closed. Where the account has been open for at least thirty-six whole months, counted the same way, and the acres enrolled on it are below that threshold, the prior season spend is the lesser of the 14 statement month total and that two-year average, less every discount granted on the account as a discount line of its own, which is an early pay, volume, prepay or programme rebate discount and never the restocking charge withheld inside a credit memo, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places. In every other case no such alternative measure is taken on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

## The months open and the acres together

| Whole months the account has been open, counted from the date it was opened to the handling date | Acres enrolled against the programme's rebate threshold | The prior season spend |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 36 or more | at or above the threshold | Half of everything invoiced over the 26 statement months, less every discount line granted (an early pay, volume, prepay or programme rebate discount, and never the restocking charge withheld inside a credit memo), rounded half away from zero to two decimal places, which is the average of the two crop years just closed |
| 36 or more | below the threshold | The lesser of the 14 statement month total and that two-year average, less the same discount lines, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places |
| fewer than 36 | any | No alternative measure |

An account 35 whole months open at the handling date stands outside the clause whatever the acres; at 36 whole months it is inside it.

## The rebate threshold in acres

| Programme | Rebate threshold (acres) |
| --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 0 |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 0 |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 0 |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 0 |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 500 |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 1000 |

*Hypothetical reading.* An account 40 months open on the Full Acre Input Financing Account with 620 acres enrolled is at or above that programme's threshold of 500 acres: everything invoiced over the 26 statement months comes to 500000.00 USD, half of that is 250000.00 USD, and less discount lines granted of 2000.00 USD the prior season spend is 248000.00 USD. Had 430 acres been enrolled, the measure would instead be the lesser of the 14 statement month total and that 250000.00 USD average, less the same discounts.
